facts.fact: ARCEP Togo's page describes a certification authority that accredits trust service providers and auditors and publishes an official trust list.

ARCEP Togo's trust list shows three trust service providers (Axendit Togo, Augura Technologies Togo, Chronoservices International) accredited on 19 February 2026 for three years, with no qualified auditor yet.

systems.tiers: accredited providers; qualified providers; qualified auditors (none yet)

TGO.note: The page names no electronic transactions or e-commerce law, only unnamed applicable texts and regulations.
The page concerns certification rules for trust services only, a single function, not government data-exchange standards.
